adjudication.rationale: The client enforces uniqueness via `z.array(...).refine(...)` in `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` (lines ~20-24), but the server input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` in `addGuests.schema.ts` is only `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness refinement. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails, but does not dedupe within the incoming `guests` array, so `['a@x.com','a@x.com']` can pass and be sent to `attendees.createMany({ data: guestsFullDetails })`, potentially creating duplicates or hitting a DB uniqueness constraint error. This is a correctness issue exposed by the diff.
